title: Understanding Correlation
text: The correlation matrix shows how each pair of variables is related. A correlation of $$1$$ means perfect positive correlation, $$-1$$ means perfect negative correlation, and $$0$$ means no correlation.

title: Correlation Between Critic $$1$$ and Critic $$2$$
text: The correlation between critic $$1$$ and critic $$2$$ is $$-0.70$$. This indicates a strong negative correlation, meaning as one increases, the other tends to decrease.

title: Correlation and Scalar Multiples
text: For critic $$1$$ to be a scalar multiple of critic $$2$$, their correlation should be either $$1$$ or $$-1$$, indicating a perfect linear relationship.
